from pathlib import Path
import json,shutil,datetime
root=Path('workspaces/programs')
spec=root/'selection-element-specification.md'
tmpl=root/'selection-template.tmpl'
srs=root/'scratchpad/SRS.md'
proj=root/'scratchpad/SRS.agent.json'
archive=root/'versions/v0.2.0'
archive.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for p in (tmpl,spec):
 dest=archive/p.name
 assert not dest.exists(),('existing archive must not be overwritten',str(dest))
 shutil.copy2(p,dest)
def sub(p,a,b):
 t=p.read_text()
 assert t.count(a)==1,(str(p),a[:85],t.count(a))
 p.write_text(t.replace(a,b))
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec='seconds').replace('+00:00','Z')
sub(tmpl,'"version": "0.2.0"','"version": "0.3.0"')
sub(tmpl,'"createdAt": "2026-11-04T10:24:33-08:00"',f'"createdAt": "{now}"')
sub(tmpl,'    ],\n    "instruction": {','    ],\n    "goto": <goto>,\n    "instruction": {')
sub(spec,'**Specification version:** 0.2.0','**Specification version:** 0.3.0')
sub(spec,'**Version created:** 2026-11-04T10:24:33-08:00',f'**Version created:** {now}')
sub(spec,'"version": "0.2.0",','"version": "0.3.0",')
sub(spec,'    ],\n    "instruction": {','    ],\n    "goto": <goto>,\n    "instruction": {')
sub(spec,'## Template language and compilation (v0.2.0)','## Template language and compilation (v0.3.0)')
tick=chr(96)
old='| '+tick+'selection.options[].id'+tick+' | Explicit integer selection identifier. |'
sub(spec,old,old+'\n| '+tick+'selection.goto'+tick+' | Optional array of symbolic navigation destinations and nested label groups. |')
sub(spec,'- **v0.1.0 archive:**','- **v0.2.0 archive:** [template](versions/v0.2.0/selection-template.tmpl) and [specification](versions/v0.2.0/selection-element-specification.md).\n- **v0.1.0 archive:**')
spec.write_text(spec.read_text()+'''
## Navigation destinations (v0.3.0)

The optional selection.goto field is a separate array, not part of selection.options. Each item is a single-property object whose symbolic destination key maps to an array of arrays of presentation labels. The concrete example below preserves the navigation label grouping:

    "goto": [
      {"main-menu": [["Main"], ["Back"]]},
      {"somewhere-else": []}
    ]

An empty label array is permitted but presents no navigation labels. The second destination is a structural example only, not a declared Scratchpad route. An application must render only destinations supported by its current interface and validate a requested navigation destination against those entries. No arbitrary code execution or unregistered route is permitted.

Scratchpad entry menus contain N+1 operation options when N data entries are present: option 0 New entry and 1..N Edit entry. Navigation to main-menu appears exclusively in selection.goto with label groups Main and Back, and is not assigned an option ID. The navigation response transport must be established in the pending selection-controller implementation; this template alone does not create executable navigation transitions.
''')
sub(srs,'**Specification:** TP-SRS-001, v1.2.0','**Specification:** TP-SRS-001, v1.3.0')
sub(srs,'**Template syntax:** [Selection Element Specification v0.2.0]','**Template syntax:** [Selection Element Specification v0.3.0]')
sub(srs,'- **SEC-01:** Mutations SHALL be confined','- **SP-19:** Every created or edited scratchpad data comment SHALL persist derived header.entry_count equal to the full entries.length, including historical revisions. Legacy comments without the field may be read and gain it on the next mutation. Present mismatched counts are invalid.\n- **SP-20:** The entry menu SHALL place operation choices only in selection.options (0 New entry; 1..N Edit entry), and SHALL place navigation in the separate selection.goto array, including main-menu with label groups [["Main"],["Back"]]. Navigation is not an operation option or permission for an unlisted execution route.\n- **SEC-01:** Mutations SHALL be confined')
j=json.loads(proj.read_text())
j['version']='1.3.0'
j['source']['revision']='1.3.0'
j['requirements']+= [
 {'id':'SP-19','behavior':'Maintain persisted derived header.entry_count equal to full entries.length after each mutation, while allowing legacy documents lacking count until changed'},
 {'id':'SP-20','behavior':'Keep N+1 entry operation IDs in options and navigation separately in goto, with main-menu label groups Main and Back'}
]
j['data']['comment']['header']['entry_count']='derived_integer_equals_entries.length'
j['data']['entry_selection']={'operation_ids':'0=new, 1..N=edit','options_count':'N+1','goto':[{'main-menu':[['Main'],['Back']]}],'navigation_rule':'only current declared symbolic destinations'}
proj.write_text(json.dumps(j,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print('UPDATED_DOC_FILES')
